reserveReview.reviewer: OpenAI Codex UTY reserve curation; Claude ODR-E9 location-bucket join repair
reserveReview.rationale: Re-opened 2026-09-01 against the Accountable reserves_split payload (dashboard timestamp 2026-09-01T10:15:39Z, USD 13,837,236.09 across fourteen buckets). The prior 2026-08-28 curation covered Base, Ethereum, Avalanche and Copper only. Since then the bucket set moved: the production adapter rounds shares to one decimal and drops anything that rounds to 0.0, so Katana (USD 6,988.88, 0.0505%) crossed into the captured set while Copper (USD 5,379.64, 0.0389%) fell out of it. No reviewed row was named Katana, so the captured Katana exposure compiled with no assetClass and no failure domain. The composition is now curated from the raw source shares rather than the adapter's rounded output, and it covers every bucket down to Hyperliquid (0.0022%); the eight remaining buckets total USD 18.58, or 0.0002%, and are omitted as dust within the composition tolerance. Carrying Copper and Hyperliquid keeps a reviewed row available for the buckets that sit either side of the adapter's rounding threshold, so the same defect does not recur the next time one crosses it. These are location/custody or settlement buckets, not asset classes, so every row stays conservatively classified as assetClass other with the same YieldPoint (XSY) managed-strategy and undisclosed custody/venue-counterparty failure domain. YieldPoint's flow documentation says USDC is minted 1:1 and swept to a custodian, while XSY's public mechanics describe strategy modules and give long-spot/short-perpetuals only as examples; the sources do not publish the current strategy assets, retained USDC, hedge notionals, margin, venue balances, custody-provider shares, or liquidation buffers. No UTY sourceKeyMap is configured, so the reviewed rows intentionally match the live bucket names exactly and do not imply asset-level itemization.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Accountable reserves_split location/custody snapshot read 2026-09-01, taken as raw bucket shares of the USD 13,837,236.09 positive-bucket total rather than the live adapter's one-decimal rounding, interpreted with current XSY/YieldPoint flow, strategy, and risk disclosures
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The 99.9998% figure reflects that every published Accountable location envelope remains unitemized at asset level and is therefore unresolved for reserve composition; it does not assert that the managed strategy is absent. XSY and Accountable do not itemize the strategy's retained USDC, long/short positions, margin, venue balances, custody-provider allocation, or liquidation buffers within any location bucket. The residual 0.0002% is the eight sub-0.001% buckets omitted as dust.
